integrity: The exact finite recurrence was checked against independent full-edge-order enumeration; a proof derives the fluid law, terminal martingale CLT, and sharp ratio. Computations corroborate and do not certify the asymptotic arguments; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete split graphs with uniform eligible-edge selection; limiting positive part densities; extreme aspect ratios, other selection policies and other split graphs are not covered. Priority checks are limited by full-text availability of older general-graph papers.
title: Sharp random-edge matching efficiency and Gaussian losses on complete split graphs
